datasets.label: Orders
datasets.note: One row per order, money already totalled (v_order_summary).

datasets.label: Customers
datasets.note: Lifetime value and recency per customer; cancelled and refunded excluded (v_customer_360).

datasets.label: Products
datasets.note: Catalogue with units sold and revenue (v_product_performance).

datasets.label: Needs restock
datasets.note: Active products at or below their reorder level.

datasets.label: Daily sales
datasets.note: Revenue per day; cancelled and refunded excluded (v_daily_sales).

datasets.label: Balance detail (A/R)
datasets.note: Every unpaid invoice with its aging bucket (v_customer_balance). Unpaid = status 'pending'.

datasets.label: A/R aging summary
datasets.note: Open balances per customer, bucketed by age (v_ar_aging).

datasets.label: Profit by product
datasets.note: Where the gross profit came from — revenue, COGS and margin per product.

datasets.label: Inventory value
datasets.note: Stock on hand carried at cost — the asset-side figure (v_product_performance).

datasets.label: Voice aliases
datasets.note: What people actually say out loud, mapped to rows (ai_entity_alias).

datasets.label: Intents
datasets.note: Questions the assistant is meant to answer (ai_intent).

datasets.label: Conversation log
datasets.note: Every spoken turn: what was heard, what SQL it became, how it went (ai_utterance).
